title: Basis matrix of the bond space from a maximal forest
statement: Let $D$ be a finite digraph with vertex set $V$ and arc set $A$, specified by its tail and head maps $A \to V$, and let $F$ be a field. Let $T$ be a maximal forest of $D$, and for each arc $a \in T$ let $g_a$ denote the potential difference of the fundamental bond of $a$, that is, $g_a = \delta p_a$ where $p_a$ is the indicator function of the vertex set of that bond. Then the matrix over $F$ whose rows are the functions $g_a$, indexed by the arcs $a \in T$, is a basis matrix of the bond space $\mathcal{B}$ of $D$; equivalently, the family $(g_a)_{a \in T}$ is a basis of $\mathcal{B}$.
hypotheses_covered: finite digraph on vertex set V and arc set A given by tail/head maps
T is a maximal forest of the digraph
